input.STYLE_GUIDE:
# Lumen Docs Style Guide

- Write in second person ("you"), not third person ("the user").
- Do not use Latin abbreviations (e.g., i.e., etc.). Use plain English instead ("for example," "that is," "and so on").
- After the first mention in a page, refer to the product as "Lumen," not "the Lumen API."
- Use "API key," not "token," when referring to the credential used to authenticate requests.

# Getting Started

The Lumen API lets developers send real-time events. To get started, the user needs to generate a token from the dashboard.

Once the user has a token, they can call the Lumen API to send events, e.g. order.created or user.signed_up.

The Lumen API also supports webhooks, i.e. it can notify your server when something happens.
